People used to say the Tesla Semi is unreal, that Tesla won’t be able to hit the goals they aim for and blah blah blah.
But today is today.

WattEV just placed a $100 million order for 370 Tesla Semis, the largest single electric truck deployment in California history.

WattEV used to be one of Nikola’s biggest electric truck customers. They bought 36 Nikola Tre trucks. They ran them. Then Nikola filed for bankruptcy in February 2025.

WattEV took the lessons, ran a public RFP and chose Tesla.

~ 370 Tesla Semis 
~ $100 million 
~ Largest single electric truck order in California history 
~ 300+ going to the Port of Oakland 
~ Megawatt charging hubs in Oakland, Fresno, Stockton and Sacramento 
~ Full fleet by end of 2027

When the customer with the most direct experience comparing electric trucks in real freight operations picks Tesla, the market has chosen.

UPDATE: Awkward photo cropping just got replaced by AI.

Grok Imagine can now instantly change the aspect ratio of photos, making it easy to turn one image into formats for X, Instagram, YouTube and more without manually reframing everything.

Instead of cutting off parts of the image, the AI intelligently expands and adapts the scene to fit the new layout.

A small feature on paper, but a huge quality-of-life upgrade for creators.

Super Heavy V3 just completed a full-duration 33-engine static fire.

All 33 Raptors fired at full thrust, marking one of the most powerful ground tests SpaceX has ever performed.

This is a major step toward the next phase of Starship development. Every successful static fire pushes the system closer to rapid reusability and higher flight cadence.

🚨 BREAKING: Elon Musk Tours Intel’s D1X/D1D Fab in Hillsboro, Oregon Today

Elon Musk was spotted at Intel’s primary global semiconductor research facility — the heart of their next-gen 18A and 14A process development — alongside teams and family.

This visit signals major momentum for Terafab — the ambitious joint project between Tesla, SpaceX, xAI, and Intel to build one of the world’s largest AI chip manufacturing complexes in Texas. Terafab aims for massive-scale production using Intel’s advanced 14A tech to secure domestic compute capacity for AI, EVs, and space applications. 

Silicon is waking up. Things are in motion.

xAI launched Image Generation Quality Mode on its API.

The model has already generated more than 300 million images through Grok, and now developers can tap into the same system directly.

Quality Mode focuses on higher realism, improved text rendering and tighter creative control, making it more useful for professional and commercial workflows.

AI image generation is moving fast from fun experiments to serious production tools.
